name: Status And Reason 46
definition: Provides details related to the status of the order.

AffirmationStatus.name: Affirmation Status
AffirmationStatus.definition: Status of affirmation of a trade.

UnaffirmedReason.name: Unaffirmed Reason
UnaffirmedReason.definition: Specifies the reason why the instruction has an unaffirmed status.

AdditionalReasonInformation.name: Additional Reason Information
AdditionalReasonInformation.definition: Provides additional information about the reason in narrative form.

AdditionalReasonInforrmationRule.definition: The AdditionalReasonInformation element must not contain information that can be provided in a structured field unless bilaterally agreed.

UnaffirmedReasonRule.definition: If AffirmationStatus is Unaffirmed then UnaffirmedReason must be present.
